events.pleaseNote: Strict Bag Policy Enforced. No Re-Entry.

accessibility.info: Wheelchair accessible locations are in Sections 117, 118, 119, 120, 121, and 227. There is also an area on the main floor.

ticketLimit.info: There is an eight (8) ticket limit per person.

venues.name: DECC Symphony Hall

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: Mon - Fri 10:00 am - 5:00 pm Sat 10:00 am - 2:00 pm Closed on Sunday unless there is an event going on that day. Summer Hours: Mon - Fri 10:00 am - 5:00 pm Closed on Saturday and Sunday unless there is an event that day.
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: Cash, money orders, Visa, MasterCard, Discover, and American Express.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will Call tickets can be picked up no earlier than 90 minutes prior to the show at the Box Office Will Call Window. Customers must present the actual credit card used to place the order, a valid picture ID and the order number.

venues.parkingDetail: Parking at the DECC & AMSOIL Arena https://decc.org/parking-directions/parking/ Additional Parking Options around DECC & AMSOIL Arena https://decc.org/parking-directions/parking-resources/
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: Accessible seating is available on the main floor, sections B and C, row GG. Although an elevator goes to the lower balcony, stairs are required to get to your seats. Please do not order balcony tickets if unable to do stairs.

generalInfo.generalRule: The DECC is a gun-free facility. Cameras and recording devices are not permitted. Outside food and beverage are not permitted.
generalInfo.childRule: Patrons ages 12 months and older require a ticket.
